legend: An unordered pair of natural numbers is called good if one of the numbers divides the other. Output n$$$n$$$ such natural numbers not exceeding one million, such that there are exactly k$$$k$$$ good pairs among them, or determine that this is impossible.

More formally: for the numbers output by your program a1$$$a_1$$$, a2$$$a_2$$$, ..., an$$$a_n$$$, there must be exactly k$$$k$$$ pairs of indices i$$$i$$$, j$$$j$$$, where i<j$$$i  \lt  j$$$, such that ai$$$a_i$$$ divides aj$$$a_j$$$ or aj$$$a_j$$$ divides ai$$$a_i$$$.
input: Two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ are given, each on a separate line (1≤n≤105$$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$, 0≤k≤105$$$0 \le k \le 10^5$$$).
output: Output n$$$n$$$ such natural numbers in the range from 1 to 106$$$10^{6}$$$, such that there are exactly k$$$k$$$ good pairs among them. If there are multiple correct answers, output any. If there are no solutions, output -1.
Subtask 3 (up to 40 points): no additional constraints.

legend.ai: 如果一个数对中的一个数能被另一个数整除，则称这个无序自然数对是好的。请输出 n$$$n$$$ 个不超过一百万的自然数，使其中恰好有 k$$$k$$$ 个好数对，或者判定这是不可能的。
更形式化地说：对于你的程序输出的数 a1$$$a_1$$$、a2$$$a_2$$$、...、an$$$a_n$$$，必须恰好存在 k$$$k$$$ 对下标 i$$$i$$$、j$$$j$$$，满足 i<j$$$i  \lt  j$$$，且 ai$$$a_i$$$ 整除 aj$$$a_j$$$ 或 aj$$$a_j$$$ 整除 ai$$$a_i$$$。

output.ai: 输出 n$$$n$$$ 个取值范围在 1 到 106$$$10^{6}$$$ 之间的自然数，使得其中恰好有 k$$$k$$$ 个合法数对。如果有多个正确答案，输出任意一个即可。如果无解，输出 -1。
子任务 3（最多 40 分）：无额外约束。
